analyst_view.overall: Early view: Fortuna host PEC, who will be about four weeks into Alex Pastoor's spell as coach. Fortuna have drawn four of their last five and Danny Buijs is worried about injuries; PEC have scored only 13 in 12 games and drew 1-1 at bottom side Willem II.

goals.text: The numbers say 3 goals. I lean lower: PEC's attack is one of the weakest in the league, Fortuna keep drawing, and a new coach usually makes PEC more cautious away from home.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.2 corners. Nothing in either team's news points to a change in style, so I keep it.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards. Mid-table against lower half, no rivalry and no bans; I agree with the estimate.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots. Fortuna should have more of the ball at home, and that is already in the split.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.3 shots on target. With PEC's low scoring and Fortuna's injury problems, I expect a little less.
